observation.visible_scene: A close-up, top-down view of a wet asphalt road surface. A shallow puddle covers the central-left area, and within it sits a bright, smooth oval reflection (a glossy highlight surrounded by a darker rim). Scattered pebbles and a pale stone near the top edge frame the scene; the rest of the surface is dark, glistening aggregate.
visible_changes: No motion is detectable across the excerpt: the bright oval reflection keeps the same shape, size, position and highlight orientation from the first to the last frame.
The surrounding pebbles, the pale top stone and the wet-surface texture remain in fixed positions, indicating a static camera and a static scene.
No ripples, splashes, or expanding rings appear on the water surface during the sampled interval.
The overall brightness and contrast of the reflection do not change in any noticeable way over the ~2.7 s window.
observation.outside_clip_unknowns: Whether raindrops are striking the surface before or after this window (and any ripples they would cause) is not shown; the cause of the still reflection is unknown.
observation.uncertain_details: Sub-frame or very low-amplitude water motion, if any, is below the resolution of these samples; the oval is ambiguous between a sky/light reflection on the water and a small submerged object; minute camera drift cannot be fully ruled out but no relative motion is evident.
